en: The postcard features a sepia-toned photograph of a stately manor house situated at the end of a gravel driveway, flanked by two smaller buildings and surrounded by carefully maintained hedges and large trees. The architecture hints at a European origin, with the main building displaying a symmetrical facade, multiple windows, and a modest decorative pediment above the entrance. In the top right corner of the postcard, there is handwritten text which appears to say 'Hammarö'.
